boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Rockhurst study settings with documented layouts, tools, and constraints.

cards.title: Greenlease Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Collaborative study and events level
cards.notes: Bring a group project here for movable tables, mobile whiteboards, computers, printing, long tables, and plentiful electrical outlets.
cards.short_summary: A flexible library floor set up for collaborative work and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenlease Library describes its first floor as collaborative study and events space with movable tables, mobile whiteboards, computers, a printer, long tables, and electrical outlets.
cards.access_notes: Library space; its listed first-floor study room is first come, first serve.

cards.title: Greenlease Library Mezzanine Level
cards.subtitle: Study rooms and Library Classroom (LIB 001)
cards.notes: Use one of the seven study rooms for individual or group work, or check whether LIB 001 is available for group study.
cards.short_summary: A room-focused library level with seven first-come study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists seven mezzanine study rooms for individual or group study, first come first serve, plus the Library Classroom (LIB 001) for Manresa courses and group study.
cards.access_notes: Seven study rooms are first come, first serve; LIB 001 also serves Manresa courses.

cards.title: Greenlease Library Top Level
cards.subtitle: Dedicated quiet individual-study area
cards.notes: Choose this level when you need a quieter solo session; use a carrel or a study pod, both listed for individual study.
cards.short_summary: The library’s dedicated quiet area, with carrels and private-study pods.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenlease Library identifies its top level as a dedicated quiet area for individual study with study pods for extended private study and carrels for individual study.
cards.access_notes: The listed top-level study room and study pods are first come, first serve.

cards.title: Greenlease Library Ground Level
cards.subtitle: Collaborative tables and whiteboards
cards.notes: Set up a working session at a movable table and use the multiple whiteboards; plug in at the level’s listed electrical outlets.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative library level with movable worktables and several whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenlease Library lists its ground level for collaborative study and events, with movable tables, electrical outlets, and multiple whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: The STEAM Studio on this level is reserved for teaching and learning events.

cards.title: Arrupe 312 (Glass Room)
cards.subtitle: Pedro Arrupe, S.J., Hall
cards.notes: Plan a group session around the floor-to-ceiling whiteboards and TV, with natural light supporting shared project work.
cards.short_summary: A bright group-work room with wall-to-wall writing space and a TV.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists Arrupe 312, the Glass Room, as having natural lighting, floor-to-ceiling whiteboards, and a TV for group projects.
cards.access_notes: Located in Pedro Arrupe, S.J., Hall; verify room availability before settling in.

cards.title: Arrupe Second Floor Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Pedro Arrupe, S.J., Hall
cards.notes: Use the ceiling-to-floor whiteboards for problem sets and choose among the seating styles; bring a charger for the available outlets.
cards.short_summary: An open mezzanine with large whiteboards, daylight, outlets, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists the Arrupe Second Floor Mezzanine with ceiling-to-floor whiteboards, different seating styles, natural light, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: This is a high-foot-traffic area near faculty offices and the Wisdom Core Reflection site.

cards.title: Science Center 206 (Balcony)
cards.subtitle: St. Ignatius Science Center
cards.notes: Bring a partner or small group to use the spacious room’s whiteboards and computers, with outlets and a microwave also listed.
cards.short_summary: A spacious science-building workspace with computers, whiteboards, and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists Science Center 206 (Balcony) as spacious and equipped with whiteboards, outlets, computers, and a microwave.
cards.access_notes: Located in St. Ignatius Science Center; check availability if it is needed for academic use.

cards.title: Aylward-Dunn Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Van Ackeren Hall
cards.notes: Work near tutoring support and use the natural light, study-skills books, whiteboard space, and academic help described by Rockhurst.
cards.short_summary: A study setting paired with tutoring, writing help, and academic-support resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists the Learning Center as having access to tutors, natural light, study-tip books, and substantial whiteboard space.
cards.access_notes: The Learning Center is in Van Ackeren Hall; Rockhurst states its tutoring and academic-support services are free for RU students.

cards.title: Conway Hall Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Conway Hall
cards.notes: If you commute, use the lounge’s wipe board, chargers, kitchen area with microwave, and beanbag-style living area between classes.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor commuter study lounge with charging, whiteboard, and kitchen amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst describes Conway Hall’s third-floor Commuter Lounge as a study space for commuters with a living area, beanbag, wipe board, chargers, free coffee, and microwave kitchen space.
cards.access_notes: Designed as a study space for commuters on Conway Hall’s third floor.

cards.title: Sedgwick 103 Learning Studio
cards.subtitle: Sedgwick Hall
cards.notes: Use the large learning studio when you need room to spread out while staying near campus circulation and academic spaces.
cards.short_summary: A large Sedgwick study room positioned close to foot traffic.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists Sedgwick Hall 103 as a Learning Studio that is a large room with no people going in and out, while remaining close to foot traffic.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Sedgwick Hall; confirm availability before using the room.
